text:
alex: Heads up — small but noisy signal: our longtail/rare-intent holdout is showing depletion after the last ingest. Lots of samples moved into the main bank, possible leak into canary.

maria: ugh. I saw higher pass rates on the golden for the new quant4b run — thought it was good, now worried it's just overlap.

sam: Can you point to examples? is this dedupe or an upstream sampler bug?

alex: quick sample snippet (from holdout):
```
{"id":"h-1092","prompt":"How do I cancel my subscription from a third-party reseller?","source":"ingest-2026-03-18","fingerprint":"sha1:abc123"}
```
This exact prompt appears in a recent seedbank dump that feeds production sampling.

tara: That's the one. We recently backfilled from a small vendor dataset to increase rare-intent coverage, but the de-dup pipeline may not have normalized entity variants.

josh: Action items? I can run a diff between holdout fingerprints and the latest seedbank snapshot.

maria: Please do. Also tag the failing quant4b jobs — if the canary had leaked, quality delta numbers are meaningless.

ci-bot: [deploy] Started job quant4b-canary-2026-03-22 (job id q-7789)

sam: Quick checklist I suggest:
- run fingerprint diff (seedbank vs holdout)
- sample N=500 overlaps for manual review (mix of intents)
- check labeler queues for golden contamination
- rerun quant4b canary with a purified holdout if overlap > 0.5%

alex: I ran a lightweight fingerprint diff already: ~0.8% overlap concentrated in support/account-intents.

tara: ok that's above our 0.5% threshold. Josh — can you generate the overlap sample and put it in the /shared/curation/rarewash/ directory? Name it overlap-1767809000.csv

josh: On it. Will include columns: id, fingerprint, source, matched_seed_id, normalized_prompt (lower+strip punctuation).

maria: Labelers: hold off on golden updates for this batch. We'll rerun the quant canary with cleansed holdout. Also we should add a normalization pass to the dedupe pipeline for the vendor backfill.

alex: Can someone estimate turnaround? If labeler review is needed, probably 24-36h. If we just remove exact fingerprint matches we can unblock faster but risk near-duplicates.

sam: I can coordinate the labeler microtask. If we prioritize the 500 overlap samples, we can get human review in ~8-12h (we have 3 labelers available).

tara: Also adding to backlog: add vendor-normalization rule (strip reseller suffixes, map common vendor names) and run through a test corpus. I'll file ticket and link here.

alex: thanks. Josh, please paste the S3 link when ready and tag @sam. We'll pause the quant metrics until the rerun.

josh: Uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/rarewash/overlap-1767809000.csv.gz -- @sam tagging now.

sam: got it. spinning up the microtask and will post results.

maria: Once we confirm no leak, we'll re-run quant4b-canary and re-evaluate the delta. If leak persists across other seedbanks, we might need a temporary hold on canaries ingest.

alex: TL;DR: leak found (~0.8%), overlap sample created, labeler microtask queued. Pause golden updates and quant canary metrics until cleanup.

tara: Adding note: worth updating the holdout monitoring alert to include a daily fingerprint overlap summary so this doesn’t slip.

ci-bot: [task] Created ticket CUR-512: vendor-normalization-rule-for-dedupe (assignee: tara)

sam: I'll post back with labeler verdicts in ~10h. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
